subject: Finalize production launch window, fallback owners & ops call
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Baxter <tbaxter@acme-devs.com>, Priya Rao <procurement@acme.com>, Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@acme.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Finalize production launch window, fallback owners & ops call

Hi Tom / Priya / Lina —

Thanks for getting us into the final stretch. We want to lock the production launch planning call where we walk through the cutover play, fallback owners, and the final verification checklist. Attendees we recommend: AE (Aditya), SE (Marissa), Ops/Prod Eng (Lina), Procurement (Priya), Security (security-team@acme.com), and myself to coordinate escalation.

Proposed windows (PT):
- Wed Mar 1 — 10:00–11:00
- Wed Mar 1 — 12:00–13:00
- Thu Mar 2 — 09:00–10:00

Please reply with the preferred slot or propose an alternative. I attached the current MOP (master ops plan) and a working spreadsheet for fallback owners so you can confirm names/contacts before the call.

Pre-reads / asks before the call:
- Security: complete the checklist page in the MOP and confirm audit lead
- Procurement: share expected PO/contract sign-off timeline
- Prod Eng: confirm the rollback trigger thresholds you want to use (latency, error-rate, memory)

I’ll send a calendar invite once we have a firm slot. If it helps, I can run a 20-min dry run with the SE/AE first.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

— Irene Choi
Sr. Program Manager, Customer Launches
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: acme-prod-launch-mop.pdf, fallback-owners-sheet.xlsx)

From: Tom Baxter <tbaxter@acme-devs.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <procurement@acme.com>, Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@acme.com>, security-team@acme.com, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Finalize production launch window, fallback owners & ops call

Irene — thanks. Wed Mar 1 looks good overall but our primary constraint is that our SRE lead (Michael Chen) is tied up until midday. Couple quick notes: 

- We cannot do 10:00 PT because Michael is in a recording until 11:30 PT. 12:00 PT works for the core team.
- Can you add our audit lead (security-audit@michael-chen.acme) to the invite? They need to be present for the checklist sign-off.
- Please include a short agenda — we need to confirm the exact rollback triggers and the window for running the traffic ramp.

I reviewed the attachments quickly; the fallback sheet looks good. Agenda suggestion: 1) Cutover timeline and owners (20m) 2) Rollback criteria & triggers (15m) 3) Security checklist sign-off (10m) 4) Procurement/PO timing (5m)

If 12:00 PT is ok for Redwood, we’ll accept that.

— Tom
Director, Infrastructure
Acme Robotics
(Please add: Michael Chen <michael.chen@acme-devs.com>)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Baxter <tbaxter@acme-devs.com>, Priya Rao <procurement@acme.com>, Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Finalize production launch window, fallback owners & ops call

Thanks Irene / Tom — quick internal check: Marissa and I are available on Mar 1 but prefer 12:00 PT (aligns with our SE/AE schedules and gives Michael time).

We’ll come prepared to lead the Cutover Timeline & Owners section and to confirm the canary ramp schedule. Action items for our side before the call:
- Marissa: prepare short runbook for cache/inference warm-up steps (5 slides)
- Aditya: prepare SLA/LAT thresholds and suggested rollback knobs
- Irene: send calendar invite & list of final fallback owners so we can verify contacts

If security/audit needs additional evidence before sign-off, tell us what artifact (log ranges, retention settings) you need and we’ll surface it ahead of the call.

— Aditya
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Baxter <tbaxter@acme-devs.com>, Michael Chen <michael.chen@acme-devs.com>, Priya Rao <procurement@acme.com>, Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@acme.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, security-team@acme.com
Date: Fri, 26 Feb 2027 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Finalize production launch window, fallback owners & ops call

All — thanks for the quick replies. 12:00 PT on Wed Mar 1 is confirmed. I’ve created a calendar event and added Michael and the audit lead. Link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=prod-launch-acme-0301

Agenda (30m):
- 12:00–12:05: Quick intros & objectives
- 12:05–12:20: Cutover timeline & owners (Aditya/Marissa)
- 12:20–12:27: Rollback criteria & verification steps (Tom/Michael + Marissa)
- 12:27–12:30: Procurement next steps & PO timing (Priya)

Immediate asks before the call (please do by EOD Tue Feb 28):
- Security / audit: confirm which artifact(s) you need from the MOP. If you need log excerpts, tell us the time window and retention period.
- Procurement: share expected PO date and any billing info required (invoice name / PO number format).
- Prod Eng: fill in the fallback owner column in the attached spreadsheet (sheet: "Final Owners" tab).

Attachments reattached: acme-prod-launch-mop.pdf, fallback-owners-sheet.xlsx

I will run a 20-minute dry run with Aditya & Marissa on Tue Feb 28 at 08:30 PT; invite is optional for anyone who wants to join.

See you all Wed.

— Irene
Sr. Program Manager, Customer Launches
Redwood Inference
(Attachments: acme-prod-launch-mop.pdf, fallback-owners-sheet.xlsx)

From: Priya Rao <procurement@acme.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Tom Baxter <tbaxter@acme-devs.com>, Michael Chen <michael.chen@acme-devs.com>
Cc: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@acme.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2027 17:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Finalize production launch window, fallback owners & ops call

Irene / team — confirmed on our side. PO approval expected by Mar 5; I will send a provisional PO number during the call and a final PO by EOD Mar 5.

Attendees from procurement on the call: Priya Rao (me) + Arman Patel (billing). We will not need additional artifacts beyond the contract summary — if the audit team needs an invoice sample, let me know and I’ll prepare it.

See you at 12:00 PT.

Thanks,
Priya Rao
Head of Procurement, Acme Robotics
(Attendees: Arman Patel <arman.patel@acme.com>)
